description: 6 months on from the release date and Soccer96's Jupiter Masterdrive continues to inspire a diverse range of artists and DJs. The record worked its way into the legendary hands of Danny Krivit, who liked it so much he crafted a special lengthened edit of nu jazz groover Flight Formation. At a similar time, a young producer bought the 7" and a week later we had his bumpy, head-nodding house flip of Step Overs in our inbox - it was too good to pass up, so here's a digital release of the two re-works, with a vinyl on the cards for later in 2015.
